FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.label: Orbital Fuel Depot
FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.desc: Stores and processes fuel for spacecraft. Essential for maintaining orbital operations and supporting space travel.

FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.label: Asteroid Mining Platform
FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.desc: Automated mining drones harvest resources from nearby asteroids and space debris. Much more efficient than planetary mining.

FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.label: Solar Collection Array
FactionColonies.BuildingFCDef.desc: Massive solar panel arrays with no atmospheric interference collect energy directly from the star. Powers the station and provides surplus energy.
